name: Invoke
title: Invoke: free Midjourney alternative
job: Makes AI art on your computer
caption:
Midjourney charges $10/month to make AI art. Invoke does it on your own computer for free 🎨

✅ Type a prompt, get an image, no credits to count
✅ Canvas to paint, inpaint and outpaint your images
✅ Runs Flux, SDXL, Stable Diffusion and more
✅ Everything stays on your machine, 100% free

💻 Windows · Mac · Linux
ℹ️ It runs on your own hardware: Windows and Linux want an NVIDIA or AMD GPU, Macs need Apple Silicon (16GB+ memory recommended), and models are multi-GB downloads

Comment "PROMPT" and I'll DM you the link 🔗

Follow @itsongit for a new free open-source find every day

beats.say: Why are you still paying ten bucks a month for Midjourney?
Midjourney charges ten dollars a month. Invoke costs nothing.
Type a prompt, and it makes the image right on your own computer.
Paint over any spot, and it redraws just that part. Or grow the picture past its edges.
It runs Flux, SDXL and Stable Diffusion, with no credits to count.
It's Midjourney, minus the monthly bill.
Comment Prompt, and I'll send you the link.
